plugin.name: Runbooks
plugin.description: Runbooks an agent proposes and a person runs, one approved command at a time, with every output kept.

use.title: Use Runbooks
use.description: Read runbooks and run their steps on hosts you can connect to.

manageTokens.title: Manage Runbooks tokens
manageTokens.description: Make and revoke the tokens agents use to propose runbooks.

list.emptyHint: An agent with a Runbooks token proposes them; they show up here.

runbook.noSteps: This runbook has no steps yet.

step.missing: Values missing: {{names}}. This step cannot run until they are set.
step.notesPlaceholder: Notes for this step. Saved when you leave the box; agents can read them.
step.agentCommandOn: What the agent will run on {{host}}

run.ok: The command finished with exit code 0.
run.notOk: The command failed or a check did not pass. See the step.
run.byTerminal: Sent to a terminal by {{user}} at {{time}}
run.agentFailed: Marked failed by the agent {{user}} at {{time}}
run.pasteFirst: Paste the output first: at least one line.
run.pastePlaceholder: Paste the terminal output here, then mark the step done or failed.

repeat.titleStep: This step already ran. Run it again?
repeat.titleHash: This command ran on this host in the last 24 hours. Run it again?

order.title: Earlier steps are still pending
order.hint: Not done yet: {{steps}}. Run this step anyway?

terminal.openFailed: Could not open a terminal. Copy the command instead.
terminal.timeout: The terminal to {{host}} did not connect in time. Copy the command instead.
terminal.missing: Send to terminal needs the SSH Terminal plugin. Copy the command instead.
terminal.noHost: This host is not available to you.
terminal.notSsh: {{host}} is not an SSH host, so it has no terminal to send to.
terminal.sent: Typed into {{host}}. Press Enter there, then paste the output here.
terminal.sendFailed: Could not type into the terminal. Copy the command instead.

tokens.title: Agent tokens
tokens.intro: An agent uses a token to propose runbooks and read their results. A token can never run a command. It may name only the hosts you tick for it, and it sees the runbooks made with your tokens.
tokens.namePlaceholder: Token name, like the agent's name
tokens.once: Token for {{name}}. Copy it now: it is not shown again.
tokens.name: Name
tokens.revokeHint: Agents using it are refused from now on.
tokens.pickHosts: Tick at least one host the token may use.
tokens.noHosts: You have no SSH hosts to give a token.

link.notFound: Runbook {{id}} does not exist or is not available to you.

error.stale: The step changed since you saw it. Check the new command before you run it.

stop.title: Stop step {{position}}?
stop.hint: Runbooks sends the command a TERM signal where the server accepts one, then closes its session. The run is kept as failed, with the output so far. A command that ignores the signal may keep running on the host.

checks.title: Checks
checks.failedHint: The step is marked failed even if the command exited 0. Read the output, then Run again or Reopen the step.
checks.failedToast: Marked failed: a check did not pass on the pasted output.

wait.early: The wait is not over: {{time}} left
wait.earlyReason: The wait is not over: {{time}} left ({{reason}})

stdin.label: Standard input: {{source}}
stdin.secretWarning: The command gets this secret on its standard input: check what it does with it before you run it.
stdin.useRun: This step gets input from {{source}}: use Run

secrets.held: The output shows when the run ends: this step captures a secret.
secrets.confirm: Captures secret {{names}}: kept in OpenBao for 7 days, never shown.
